description: This source file implements the API for the SPDIF component of a TR-069 host interface, managing SPDIF device instances, attributes like Enable, Status, Alias, Name, ForcePCM, Passthrough, and AudioDelay, with functions for getting, setting, and updating these attributes.

classes.name: hostIf_STBServiceSPDIF
classes.description: Class managing SPDIF device instances, attributes, and interactions with the underlying hardware and system.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an instance of the SPDIF interface for a given device ID.

methods.name: getAllInstances
methods.description: Returns a list of all SPDIF interface instances.

methods.name: closeInstance
methods.description: Removes and deletes a specific SPDIF interface instance.

methods.name: closeAllInstances
methods.description: Removes and deletes all SPDIF interface instances.

methods.name: getLock
methods.description: Initializes and acquires a mutex lock for thread safety.

methods.name: releaseLock
methods.description: Releases the mutex lock.

methods.name: handleSetMsg
methods.description: Handles setting attributes like ForcePCM for the SPDIF interface.

methods.name: handleGetMsg
methods.description: Handles retrieving attributes such as Enable, Status, Alias, Name, ForcePCM, Passthrough, AudioDelay.

methods.name: doUpdates
methods.description: Updates the SPDIF interface attributes to the system via callback.

methods.name: getNumberOfInstances
methods.description: Returns the number of SPDIF ports available.

methods.name: setEnable
methods.description: Sets the enable state of the SPDIF device (not implemented).

methods.name: setAlias
methods.description: Sets the alias for the SPDIF device (not implemented).

methods.name: setForcePCM
methods.description: Sets the ForcePCM attribute, changing the audio encoding to PCM or display.

methods.name: getEnable
methods.description: Retrieves the enable state (not implemented).

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status, currently hardcoded as 'Enabled'.

methods.name: getAlias
methods.description: Retrieves the alias (not implemented).

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the human-readable device name (not implemented).

methods.name: getForcePCM
methods.description: Retrieves whether ForcePCM is enabled based on current encoding.

methods.name: getPassthrough
methods.description: Retrieves whether passthrough mode is enabled based on current encoding.

methods.name: getAudioDelay
methods.description: Retrieves the audio delay (not implemented).
